meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How {companyName} collects, uses and protects personal data, and how to exercise your rights under the GDPR.

title: Privacy policy
intro: This policy explains what personal data {legalName} collects through this website and in the course of its services, why, for how long, and the rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Luxembourg law.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: The data controller is {legalName}, {address}, registered with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) under number {rcs}.
For any question about your personal data or to exercise your rights, write to {email} or to the postal address above.

sections.title: The data we collect
paragraphs: We only collect the data we need for the purposes described below.
list: Quote and contact requests: your name, email address, phone number, company, location, the service you are interested in, your preferred contact method and your message.
Job applications: your name, email address, phone number, languages, availability, your CV if you choose to send one, and your message.
Clients: contact details, service addresses, access instructions you choose to give us, contract details, quotes, invoices and payments.

Website use: technical data such as your IP address and browser type, processed for security and to prevent abuse of our forms. IP addresses used for rate limiting are stored only as a one-way hash, for at most 24 hours.
Audience measurement: only if you accept it, anonymous and aggregated statistics on page visits (see our cookie policy).

sections.title: Why we use it, and on what legal basis
list: To answer your request and prepare a quote: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
To deliver our services, invoice them and manage our relationship with clients: performance of a contract (Article 6(1)(b)).
To keep accounting and tax records: compliance with our legal obligations (Article 6(1)(c)).
To assess job applications: steps taken at your request before entering into an employment contract (Article 6(1)(b)).
To secure the website, prevent spam and abuse, and keep a record of the emails we send: our legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)).
To measure audience: your consent (Article 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.title: How long we keep it
list: Quote and contact requests that do not lead to a contract: [24 months] after our last exchange.
Job applications: [6 months] after the end of the recruitment process, unless you agree that we keep your application longer for future openings.
Client records: for the duration of the contract, then for the limitation periods applicable to contractual claims.
Invoices and accounting documents: 10 years, as required by Luxembourg law.
Email logs: [12 months].
after: When a retention period ends, the data is deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: Who receives it
paragraphs: Your data is processed by our staff who need it for their work. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
We use service providers who process data on our behalf, under contracts that require them to protect it:
list: Website and database hosting: [Hosting provider], with servers located in the European Union.
File storage (CVs and documents): [Storage provider], European Union.
Email delivery: [Email provider].
Audience measurement, with your consent: [Analytics provider].
after: If a provider processes data outside the European Economic Area, we make sure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision.

sections.title: Your rights
list: access your personal data and receive a copy of it;
have inaccurate data corrected;
have your data erased, where the law allows;
restrict or object to certain processing;
receive your data in a portable format;
withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting earlier processing.
after: To exercise these rights, contact us at {email}. We may ask you to confirm your identity. We reply within one month.
You can also lodge a complaint with the Luxembourg data protection authority, the Commission nationale pour la protection des données (CNPD), at cnpd.public.lu.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We protect your data with technical and organisational measures, including encrypted connections, restricted staff access, and confidentiality agreements signed by all employees.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date at the top of the page shows when it last changed. If the change is significant, we will tell our clients directly.
